name: Stop
meaning: Come to a complete stop at the stop line (or before the crosswalk or intersection if there is no line), yield to pedestrians and cross traffic, and go only when it is safe.

name: Yield
meaning: Slow down and be ready to stop, letting vehicles, bicyclists and pedestrians already in or approaching the intersection or merge go first; continue only when the way is clear.

name: To Oncoming Traffic (plaque)
meaning: Plaque mounted below a YIELD sign telling you that you must yield the right-of-way to oncoming (opposing) traffic, such as at a one-lane bridge or a one-lane section of a two-way road.

name: All Way (plaque)
meaning: Plaque mounted below a STOP sign meaning traffic on every approach must stop; after stopping, the first vehicle to arrive goes first, and if two arrive at the same time the driver on the left yields to the driver on the right.

name: Yield Here to Pedestrians (arrow left)
meaning: Marks the yield line placed ahead of an unsignalized crosswalk; when pedestrians are crossing, yield to them at this line, well back from the crosswalk, so drivers in other lanes can also see them.

name: In-Street Pedestrian Crossing (State Law: Yield)
meaning: Placed in the roadway at an unsignalized crosswalk to remind drivers that state law requires them to yield to pedestrians within the crosswalk.

name: In-Street Pedestrian Crossing (State Law: Stop)
meaning: Placed in the roadway at an unsignalized crosswalk to remind drivers that state law requires them to stop for pedestrians within the crosswalk.

name: Speed Limit
meaning: Shows the maximum lawful speed in miles per hour for this road under good conditions; never exceed it, and drive slower when traffic, weather or road conditions require.

name: Trucks (truck speed limit plaque)
meaning: Plaque mounted below a speed limit sign giving the lower maximum speed that applies to trucks.

name: Night (night speed limit plaque)
meaning: Plaque mounted below a speed limit sign giving the lower maximum speed that applies at night.

name: Speed Limit with Minimum Speed
meaning: Shows both the maximum and the minimum lawful speeds; under normal conditions drive no faster than the upper number and no slower than the lower number.

name: Fines Double (plaque)
meaning: Plaque mounted with a speed limit or work zone sign meaning that fines for traffic violations are doubled in this zone.

name: No Right Turn
meaning: You may not turn right at this intersection.

name: No Left Turn
meaning: You may not turn left at this intersection.

name: No Turns
meaning: No turns of any kind (left, right or U-turn) are allowed at this intersection; continue straight.

name: No U-Turn
meaning: You may not make a U-turn at this location.

name: No U-Turn or Left Turn
meaning: Both left turns and U-turns are prohibited at this location.

name: No Straight Through
meaning: You may not continue straight through the intersection; you must turn.

name: Left Turn Only (lane)
meaning: Vehicles in this lane must turn left; going straight or turning right from this lane is not allowed.

name: Right Turn Only (lane)
meaning: Vehicles in this lane must turn right; going straight or turning left from this lane is not allowed.

name: Straight Only (lane)
meaning: Vehicles in this lane must go straight through the intersection; turns from this lane are not allowed.

name: Left Turn or Straight (optional movement lane)
meaning: Vehicles in this lane may either turn left or go straight.

name: Left Lane Must Turn Left
meaning: Vehicles in the left lane must turn left at the next intersection, so move out of that lane early if you want to go straight.

name: Right Lane Must Turn Right
meaning: Vehicles in the right lane must turn right at the next intersection, so move out of that lane early if you want to go straight.

name: Center Lane: Two-Way Left Turn Only
meaning: The center lane is reserved for left turns by traffic from both directions; use it only to begin or complete a left turn, never for passing or through travel.

name: HOV Lane (preferential lane, HOV 2+ only)
meaning: The lane is reserved for high-occupancy vehicles carrying at least the posted number of people (for example 2 or more) during the times shown.

name: Bike Lane
meaning: Marks a lane reserved for bicyclists; do not drive or park in it except to cross it where allowed (such as to turn), and yield to bicyclists when you do.

name: Do Not Pass
meaning: Marks a zone where passing is prohibited; do not cross the center line to pass other vehicles until the no-passing zone ends.

name: Pass With Care
meaning: Marks the end of a no-passing zone; you may pass other vehicles when the way ahead is clear and it is safe.

name: Slower Traffic Keep Right
meaning: If you are driving slower than the traffic around you, use the right lane and leave the left lane(s) for passing.

name: Trucks Use Right Lane
meaning: Trucks must travel in the right lane on this multilane roadway.

name: Keep Right
meaning: Keep to the right of the traffic island, median or obstruction ahead.

name: Keep Left
meaning: Keep to the left of the traffic island or obstruction ahead.

name: Keep Right Except to Pass
meaning: Drive in the right lane and use the left lane only to pass other vehicles.

name: Do Not Enter
meaning: You may not enter this road or ramp from this direction because traffic on it comes toward you, as at the wrong end of a one-way street or a freeway exit ramp.

name: Wrong Way
meaning: You are traveling against the flow of traffic on a one-way road or ramp; get out of the path of oncoming traffic and turn around as soon as it is safe.

name: No Trucks
meaning: Trucks are not allowed on this road.

name: No Motor Vehicles
meaning: Motor vehicles are not allowed on this road or path.

name: No Bicycles
meaning: Bicycles are not allowed on this road or facility.

name: No Pedestrians, Bicycles or Motor-Driven Cycles
meaning: Pedestrians, bicycles and motor-driven cycles are prohibited beyond this point, typically at a freeway entrance.

name: One Way
meaning: Traffic on this street moves only in the direction of the arrow; do not drive the opposite way.

name: Divided Highway Crossing
meaning: Posted on a side road where it meets a divided highway: you will cross two separate one-way roadways, so expect traffic from the left on the near roadway and from the right on the far roadway.

name: Roundabout Directional Arrow
meaning: Placed in a roundabout's central island facing entering traffic: travel to the right (counterclockwise) around the island in the direction of the arrows.

name: No Parking Any Time
meaning: Parking is prohibited at this location at all times.

name: Reserved Parking for Persons with Disabilities
meaning: This parking space is reserved for vehicles displaying a valid disability parking placard or license plate; other vehicles may not park there.

name: No Parking (symbol)
meaning: Parking is not allowed here.

name: Walk on Left Facing Traffic
meaning: Pedestrians walking along this road without a sidewalk must walk on the left side, facing oncoming traffic.

name: Cross Only at Crosswalks
meaning: Pedestrians may cross the street only within marked crosswalks.

name: No Pedestrian Crossing
meaning: Pedestrians may not cross the street at this location.

name: No Hitchhiking
meaning: Hitchhiking (standing in or beside the road to ask for a ride) is prohibited here.

name: Bicycles Allowed Use of Full Lane
meaning: Bicyclists may ride in the middle of the travel lane, so expect bicycles there and change lanes to pass them.

name: Left on Green Arrow Only
meaning: You may turn left only while the green arrow is shown, not on a circular green light.

name: Stop Here on Red
meaning: When the traffic signal is red, stop at the point shown by the arrow (the stop line), not beyond it.

name: Do Not Block Intersection
meaning: Do not enter the intersection unless there is room for your vehicle on the far side; never stop inside the intersection, even on a green light.

name: No Turn on Red (symbol)
meaning: You may not turn while the signal is red; wait for a green light or green arrow.

name: No Turn on Red
meaning: You may not turn while the signal is red; wait for a green light or green arrow.

name: Left Turn Yield on Green
meaning: When the signal shows a circular green light (not a green arrow), you may turn left but must first yield to oncoming traffic and pedestrians.

name: Turning Vehicles Yield to Pedestrians
meaning: Drivers turning at this intersection must yield to pedestrians crossing the street they are turning onto.

name: Right on Red Arrow After Stop
meaning: You may turn right on a red arrow only after coming to a complete stop and yielding to pedestrians and other traffic.

name: Right Turn on Red Must Yield to U-Turn
meaning: Drivers turning right on red must yield to opposing vehicles that are making U-turns.

name: Road Closed
meaning: The road is closed to all traffic; do not drive past this sign, and follow the posted detour.

name: Road Closed Ahead, Local Traffic Only
meaning: The road is closed some distance ahead; only local traffic going to destinations before the closure may continue past this sign.

name: Road Closed to Thru Traffic
meaning: The road is closed to through traffic; only local traffic going to homes or businesses before the closure may use it.

name: Weight Limit
meaning: Vehicles weighing more than the posted number of tons are not allowed on this road or bridge.

name: Seat Belt (Buckle Up)
meaning: Reminds drivers and passengers that seat belts must be worn.

name: Move Over or Reduce Speed
meaning: When approaching stopped emergency or service vehicles with flashing lights, move over a lane if you safely can, or otherwise slow down.

name: No Hand-Held Phone Use by Driver
meaning: Drivers may not use a hand-held phone while driving here.

name: School (school zone advance warning)
meaning: Warns that you are approaching a school or school grounds where children may be present; slow down and watch for children.

name: School Crosswalk (S1-1 with diagonal arrow plaque W16-7P)
meaning: Marks the location of a school crosswalk (the arrow points to it); slow down, watch for children and yield to pedestrians in the crosswalk.

name: School Bus Stop Ahead
meaning: Warns of a school bus stop ahead where a bus may be stopped to load or unload children; slow down, watch for children and be ready to stop.

name: When Children Are Present (plaque)
meaning: Plaque showing that the school speed limit applies whenever children are present.

name: School (plaque)
meaning: Plaque that identifies the sign it is mounted with, usually a speed limit sign, as applying to a school zone.

name: School Speed Limit Ahead
meaning: Warns that a reduced school speed limit zone begins ahead; be prepared to slow down to the school speed limit.

name: School Speed Limit (When Flashing)
meaning: Within the school zone you must not exceed the posted school speed limit while the condition shown applies (for example, when the beacons are flashing).

name: End School Zone
meaning: Marks the end of the school zone.

name: End School Speed Limit
meaning: Marks the end of the reduced school speed limit; the regular posted speed limit applies again.

name: Railroad Crossing (Crossbuck)
meaning: Marks a highway-rail grade crossing and means yield to trains: slow down, look and listen both ways, and stop if a train is approaching.

name: Number of Tracks (plaque)
meaning: Plaque below the crossbuck showing how many tracks the crossing has; after one train passes, watch for another train on a different track.

name: Exempt (railroad crossing plaque)
meaning: Tells drivers of buses, school buses and hazardous-materials vehicles that they are not required to stop at this crossing unless a train is approaching or occupying it or their view is blocked.

name: Look (railroad crossing)
meaning: Reminds drivers and pedestrians at a railroad crossing to look both ways for trains before crossing.

name: Do Not Stop on Tracks
meaning: Never stop on the railroad tracks; do not start across until there is room for your whole vehicle on the other side.

name: Tracks Out of Service
meaning: Used in place of the crossbuck where the railroad tracks have been temporarily or permanently taken out of service, meaning trains no longer use this crossing.

name: Stop Here When Flashing
meaning: Shows where you must stop when the railroad crossing's red warning lights are flashing.

name: Highway-Rail Grade Crossing Advance Warning
meaning: Warns that a railroad crossing is ahead; slow down, look and listen for trains, and be prepared to stop.

name: Low Ground Clearance Railroad Crossing
meaning: Warns that the railroad crossing ahead is raised (humped) enough that vehicles with low ground clearance, such as long trailers, could get stuck on the tracks.

name: No Train Horn (plaque)
meaning: Plaque warning that trains do not routinely sound their horns at the crossing ahead, so you must look carefully for trains yourself.

name: No Gates or Lights (plaque)
meaning: Plaque warning that the railroad crossing ahead has no automatic gates or flashing lights, so you must look and listen for trains and stop if one is coming.

name: Slow-Moving Vehicle Emblem
meaning: Displayed on the rear of farm equipment, horse-drawn vehicles and other vehicles that travel 25 mph or less; slow down early and pass only when it is safe.
